visualReview.method: Reviewed all 40 images in eight per-language five-scene contact sheets, plus full-size zh-TW edit, zh-CN Light, ar-SA Bamboo Light/read and edit, fr-FR edit, ko-KR edit.
visualReview.result: Every scene contains the real document preview; four preview themes are visually distinct, editing uses the left editor and right preview, all locales show localized text and tabs.
visualReview.arabic: Arabic glyphs are connected and readable; preview paragraphs, tasks and table align right with RTL direction. Editor remains at the left of the split view.
visualReview.fonts: French accents and Korean/CJK glyphs are visible without replacement boxes. The application uses installed fallback fonts: Segoe UI for Arabic and Malgun Gothic for Korean on this capture host.
observations: Long outline headings and some long tab/action labels use the existing application ellipsis or wrapping. No screenshot-source modification was made to alter application behavior.
visualReview.limits: Visual check is not an independent native-speaker linguistic review or an installation/Store submission test.

isolation.startup: Plain WPF Application; MarkPad.App.OnStartup and Store license flow were not invoked
isolation.documents: Repository samples copied to the unique capture state directory; original sample SHA256 verified unchanged by capture
isolation.session: RememberOpenFiles=false, empty remembered session; App.Session reset and Settings/Recovery/WebView2 isolated
